reviews.text: Thank you for the paw-sitive review!

I experienced once incident where the vet techs provided me an informational pamphlet and then verbally contradicted almost everything in the pamphlet. They got really defensive and rude when I questioned the stark differences between their verbal and written instructions. Other than that one interaction the doctor has always been quite thorough and informative and maintained a professional demeanor.
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
Poor customer service and management. Zero compassion for your pets.

I expected more from this clinic. I took my pets there in March. I took my kitten Lucy, and they always contradicted the doctor and the nurses. I told them to treat her, and the next day they called me to say she had died and had a fever. When I left her, she didn't have one, she was just dehydrated 😭. It doesn't deserve even one star. I took my other pet, a two-month-old husky named Louie, and I had another bad experience. I don't recommend this clinic. In the end, the doctor never comes to talk to you. They send the manager, who, in my opinion, has no medical experience whatsoever 😔. I don't care about all the money I paid to get them treated 😔😭. I miss them so much, I love you Lucy and Louie 💔
I've been taking my cats to Dr. Palmer since 2008. I recommended it to all my friends and family. The veterinarians, and the staff are kind and caring. I love that hospital.
Been coming here for a while with my shihtzu. Service is fine, but cost is up there a little. When you go for followup, you are charged like new exam fees, etc.,  like it is first time.
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
Best doctors i ever been to,they actually listened and do what is best for your pet. Love them
They took great care of my BillyIdol.  The all showed love and compassion.  The whole staff made me feel like they truly cared.
Sweet People with Great Attitudes!!!

The vet tech was very dismissive of our concerns.

Very disappointed in her behavior. I'm 64 and my friend is 85 and we've been cat owners and trappers, fosters and colony feeders for many, many years. We know about cats. Especially our own cats.
She was contradictory and confrontational.

She did NOT appreciate our input or descriptions of
what was going on with the cat. Kitty was post spayed and running a fever so we took her on an emergency visit.

Not impressed.

I have being going to Gulfgate Animal Hospital for over 20 years. I knew the original vet before he retired.  I took my pomeranian in because he had an infection .The staff was so patient and caring because my dog is never a happy camper and  very temperamental . The vet team was able to calm him down and give him is injection to treat his injured paw.

I went here time before last and it was good. I came back and I paid almost $400 for a halfass check on my cat. He was broken out in a red rash on his face, ears, stomach…etc. I had no clue whats wrong with him. The doctor stuck a thermometer in his butt and called it a day by writing up a list of things I could choose to pay for and take a chance that I could heal him myself. She didn’t look in his ears, listen to his heart, or look in his mouth. Not to mention the medicine I picked out for him, they shorted me a whole mL. so I paid all that money and my cat is still having issues with not enough medicine. I got blood work done too and the platelet level came back below average and didnt even bat an eyelash to look into anything. Oh and the worst part, after taking his temp she said okay you and your cat can wait in the lobby now and didnt explain anything further and she was a smartass  when discussing. She just wants these peoples money because she made the nurse be the middle man going in and out of that lobby between ever single question I had. I barely got to discuss anything at all with her bc she wanted us out. It wasn’t even busy at that time. Just be careful with this place because I’m hoping it was just a one time bad experience.
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!

Thank you for walking us through the difficult decision to let our friend, Charlie Dog, go where all GOOD AND PERFECT dogs go after this life. Your doctor and her assistant were compassionate, informative, and calm as the whole process developed. They let us say goodbye to Charlie in a compassionate, understanding and reasonably priced atmosphere. Thank you.
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
Everyone was very nice and professional. Dr. Basa (I hope I spelled her name right) was great. They handled a feral cat with great care!
Dont bother asking for an estimate. Idk about most pet owners but I dont have the money to run my dog to every clinic to get transparent pricing.

The kitten distribution system works!  Here from Phoenix (we drove with our red heeler Sam) and voila!  An orphaned kitten at our Airbnb. Def had an eye infection so brought her in to get checked out. Tested positive for parasites too. Vets tand techs were super nice and took great care of Lil Patches. A great souvenir from Houston!

I would have give negative instead of one star if I had chice.
I took my cat end of 2025 for vomiting more often.
Than she stopped eating.
They told me she is kidney  failure  and no use to spend any more money on her.  Yet,  they charged me  with a good high amount bill.
I am so glad I didn't  listen to them.
Took my cat another pet hospital. Spent much lesser. She is still with us. Her health in general  is  much better. Almost as if she is back to normal.
So. If you like your pet, don't  take it  there. And definitely  don't  listen to them.
Wrong and bad place.
This is a great low cost vet. I really that they have found a way to do walk ins and appointments.
This is the only clinic I take my pets to and have for years! Best vets in Houston! Front desk staff is hit or miss but the technicians and Veterinarians are always great!
Hello, I recommend this clinic for your pets. Excellent care.

Worse clinic harassing teenagers for traying to help a dog they found  that got shot instead of helping or pointing them to the right direction they were more focused on getting money , until they got there 50$ they let them go “””so worried about the dog’s condition””“ so quick to make a report but dint help the poor dog for crap , “money hungry” sent it back wounded instead of calling a free of charge service luckily we found some one

Dr. Palmer and her staff have always been there for my rescues. She takes her time to discuss options and prices are affordable. I trust her judgement. I have gone to Gulfgate for years and would not take my pets anywhere else.
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!

Great place for my first visit. Made this place my primary vet by the way my small dog Maya and I were treated and comforted in our time of stress. I went to a veg er last night in the heights, near where I live and it was like day and night visits with the explanation process. Not to mention the cost part, that saved Maya well over a thousand. Now, Maya will have extra money to eat and recover comfortably. Thank you Dr.Plamer and staff ♥️
Maya was misdiagnosed with cancer in the heights, just by looking I was given a treatment plan.
With an outrageous cost for that misdiagnosed treatment. In the first two sentences, cancer was mentioned. Im glad I'm friends with J3SUS and HE lead me to Gulfgate pet hospital‼️⭐️🥇⭐️

DO NOT TRUST THIS VET WITH YOUR FUR BABIES!! I’ve been a customer here for many years but today that has changed! My first dog was a patient here for a-lot of years. I got another dog and I had a horrible experience at Gulfgate Animal Hospital. My pup had a procedure done, and they sent her home with her incision still OPEN and bloody. It was extremely upsetting and completely unacceptable. When I raised concerns, they showed little urgency or care, stating they were already “closing.” I trusted them with my pet’s safety, and they failed to provide even basic post-procedure care. I would not recommend this clinic to anyone looking for attentive or compassionate veterinary service. This business needs to be investigated for malpractice and needs to be shutdown. I ended up having to take my dog to the ER because they couldn’t help her. If they had done a better job and if my dog were in better care, I wouldn’t have had to pay an additional ER bill because of their negligence to my fur baby. This place needs to take responsibility and be held accountable.
I love taking my cat here he is so happy

I have consistently had positive experiences with the veterinarian and staff, who have always been professional and attentive. I would like to suggest updating the pricing language to provide clearer expectations for the client. Specifically, wording such as “per visit/per animal” for both weekday and weekend visits as this would improve transparency. For example, for three dogs, the cost would be $51 per visit, per dog.

Dr. Palmer was an absolute pleasure to work with. She discusses the issues with terminology anyone can understand. I am happy to see she is so close to home. We just found a new partner to help with our animals.

All the vets here are extremely knowledgeable, kind, and very patient.  Dr. Palmer is a literal walking angel among us. I won’t go into details, so people don’t take advantage, but she has gone above and beyond what most vets would do to care for my very sick senior chihuahua. No matter the outcome, I will forever be grateful to Dr Palmer and the staff of this amazing vet clinic.
The Best animal hospital and all of the people are caring and amazing. This is a 10 star not just 5.

They took care of our tiny dog and were very nice and explained what could be wrong and what tests would be needed. They gave us an affordable treatment plan. I wish we had found them first. Our girl is feeling better and eating and drinking again. Thanks to Dr Rennie and Lydia and their whole staff for saving our Chica.

**UPDATE**I have come here on and off since it was a small clinic next door run by Dr. McNary. Since then they have become more expensive and a lot busier. That's not a problem. My issue is the front desk staff. Rude. Unprofessional. Dismissive. If you dont like your job, go find another. Let someone fill your position that has an ounce of compassion and sympathy. Also, try sanitizing the front waiting room once an hour, won't yah. Sick animals. Alphas peeing. Scared babies peeing or puking. C'mon. Not asking you to be perfect, but most certainly better.****AS OF TODAY 02/07/26****The office staff has made a turn around. They were super helpful and really nice. A dog had the nervous poops next to us and they were there immediately with mop and bucket. My dog has been traumatized since the last vet we took her to.(our vet retired) She was so calm after she was with Dr.Palmer and the staff. The cat didn't care either way. Lol. Still reasonably priced/going rate as other vets.
Dr Rennie is so kind and very informative!! Our pets get nervous going to the vet and she makes them very calm and is very welcoming! The staff is always so patient!

Dr. Meagan Rennie, or her assistant, overprescribed medications for profit despite me clearly stating I still had unused stock and only needed a week's worth as a precaution. On my second visit, she prescribed 90 20mg- prednisone pills, even though the dosage was reduced from 4 to 3 per day. On my first visit, it was 75 pills.
She also charged $30 for an unbranded E-collar that broke within three days. The material failed easily and created a sharp edge near my dog’s head, posing a safety hazard when the collar was supposed to aid recovery and prevent injury.

This pet hospital is one of the best in the surrounding area of SE houston. Very professional and friendly staff. This is our go to when needed . Our Bella is 100 thanks to GAH performing her surgery. Love you guys, thanks.
Actually saved me like 300 going here and the staff was top notch
They are very welcoming and knowledgable. The was staff and vet were extremely caring during the visit when we had to put our dog to sleep.
Thank you for your paw-sitive review!
Thank you for your paw-sitive review!

I expected more from this clinic. I'll give it 3 stars because of the nurse who treated my dog. She was very kind and attentive; you can tell how compassionate she is! (They speak Spanish except for the doctor.)
What I expected more from is that the doctor only prescribed a 15-minute wash for my dog's wound and infected paw. He was very weak and kept losing his balance; he couldn't even stand up. I thought they would give him a vitamin injection or something similar and properly treat the wound. But they only washed it, bandaged it, and prescribed antibiotics. Something I was already doing...

The dog was always left in very bad shape. You go there, ask for help, pay, and then you're always expected to do everything yourself as the owner, leaving your pet's life in your hands... I don't think that's right!
Thank you for your paw-sitive review!
Thank you for your paw-sitive review!

I’ve been coming to Gulfgate Animal Hospital for 20 years. I live out in Magnolia now and still make the drive to come them. Trusting vets are hard to find, no upcharges, no unnecessary treatments. Basic and trusting care. I’ve had 4 dogs and they have cared for all of them.
They treated my stuffed animal with love and patience, that's all for me, thank you.

Not sure which vet did it but a vet here stapled my cat NEXT TO his sutures then sent him home with an open surgical wound. They are also refusing to re-staple him and close the wound because he was “aggressive” when they stapled him without any pain medicine or local anesthetic.Now my cat has a staple for no reason where there is no wound. Low quality care and careless staff.

We came here for my cat because he had blood around his anus and was in pain, we asked "why was there blood around his area?," at first they weren't sure; but then they said it was because of "pancreatitus," which was probably a lie based on what happened. When they were finished with him we thought things were going smoothly until we went home and cleaned his butt area only to find out there was a burst around his anal area. It was an open wound and he was in pain when I was cleaning the area. We went the next day only to hear that the vet KNEW about the open wound and didn't tell us because it was "5:30, and she wanted to leave." We paid about $700 for the way they treated his symptoms but it's unfair because we didn't know about this and they didn't tell us on purpose.

I have had a good experience every time I visit. The staff treats you and your pet with respect. Dr. Rennie has been patient, informative, and empathetic. I used to change vets often but I now only go to Dr. Rennie.

Please, also look at the yelp reviews before y'all come here. If I could give this place 0 stars, I would. I have a bigger dog, and when I walked in, it seemed like they only had experience with or wanted to deal with smaller pets. We were secluded because of her loud bark, which I understand. But as a vet, y’all should understand that some pets get anxious in new environments and can pick up on negative energy. I’ve taken her to other vets before, and she was fine because the techs actually tried to interact with her.

I requested a female tech/ vet. Which was Lydia, and right off the bat she was rude. She asked me if I needed a minute because I looked annoyed and frustrated—which yes, I was, because of the looks I was getting. The front desk wasn’t any friendlier, except for the younger one with glasses. I was just trying to see what I could do for my fur baby. Even then what makes you think it’s okay to make a comment like that to someone? I stood there for a minute before someone acknowledged me at the front desk when I got there.

She kept making faces about the fact that my dog is 2 and that I was asking them to check her teeth—“She’s 24 months and is having dental issues??”—and made a face. I did not bring my dog here for snarky comments. She was a stray. Obviously, I know that, which is why I wanted to bring her in.

She ended up telling me that they couldn’t do anything for my dog because of her “behavioral issues,”  saying, “If she’s around other people, she wouldn’t act like that,” and that they’d need to muzzle her—but the point of me bringing her in was so they can check her mouth? She is around other dogs, children and people all the time. My dog is not an aggressive dog, she has a loud bark and gets anxious especially somewhere she has not been. Some of these techs shouldn’t even be handling pets due to their lack of patience, professionalism, and basic understanding of animal behavior. I asked if I should take my dog elsewhere, and she told me that was up to me. Throughout the whole interaction, both doors were open, so everyone could hear what she was saying. I had to ask if we could close the door. Other techs were also walking by, just being nosy. I wasn’t even really asked any questions regarding if she was stray, what she eats, or any questions regarding what i went in there for. She told me “ gently brush her teeth” like??

I told her I was leaving because I didn’t like how things were going, and she said, “That’s fine,” and shrugged her shoulders, so I just walked out. I will never recommend this place to anyone. I called back to see who the doctor was I had been speaking to, and it wasn’t even a doctor… it was a tech. HORRIBLE.
Great folks reasonable prices and no-nonsense vet care. I'll be back
They're the best!!!
Dr.Basa is the best.. she's always great with my dogs

Dr. Basa is a true angel. My fur baby was diagnosed with a very aggressive cancer a couple of months ago. Dr. Basa answered all of my questions (I had a lot). When it came time to put my baby down, she was very empathetic, kind, gentle, sweet, compassionate and loving with my baby and with us. This horrible and sad experience was a little better with her excellent bedside manners.

Excellent place! Dr. Palmer takes time to explain everything to you. I have been taking my pets here threw the last 25 plus years. Even though the other vets are good here, I prefer Dr. Palmer if a surgery needs to be done because not only does she  own the place she has the most experience.

We took our dog to Gulfgate Animal Hospital for pain in her leg. Dr Maxie charged us about $1300 to keep her there for about 3 days but after 3 days she could not tell us what was wrong with the dog and ask for $400 more at which point we realized we should take her somewhere else. We showed up at the time she requested we pick her up. 30 minutes later Dr Maxey sent her out like this. The dog had no open wounds brought there. When I looked at our dog in shock the attendant asked if there was something wrong as if this was a common thing. Dr Maxey did not show herself and did not explain what happened. They did not even offer towels for the dog dripping blood from her abdomen knowing she was about to be transported by a vehicle. We used this vet for over 10 years and trusted them even though on another occasion the same dog was diagnosed with heartworms. Since their treatment was so expensive we took her somewhere else only to be told that she did not have heartworms. At one point Dr Maxey offered euthanization for the dog even though claiming she did not know what was wrong with the dog. Upon arrival at the new vet the doctor diagnosed the problem and treated her in less than 15 minutes but Dr Maxey could not do it in 4 days. Do not trust these ppl. This review was previously posted but they somehow got it removed so it was reposted on Yelp where reviews are verified. PAY ATTENTION TO THESE REVIEWS IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR DOG!

Front office boy has a terrible attitude.

The others were very caring and helpful.
Dr. Rennie is seeing patients very fast.

Very depressed that my cats dental estimate was $1000 😢

Buyer beware! Gulfgate Animal Hospital charged me for 10 days’ worth of antibiotics but only provided enough for 6 days. When I realized the mistake, it was frustrating to think I had overpaid and potentially compromised my pet’s treatment. Always double-check your prescriptions and receipts. Very disappointed with the lack of attention to detail and follow-through.
It was my first time going today….and I must say….they are so so so so so so so so so so SOOO SOO SO nice. ☺️☺️☺️☺️

I just wanted to express my deepest gratitude to the team at gulfgate animal hospital for their kindness, fair pricing, and exceptional care. So far, I’ve brought my senior dog in for allergy issues and most recently for a dental procedure. I was genuinely shocked at how affordable their dental services were—especially compared to the other quotes I received.

My dog had 11 teeth removed, and thanks to their skill and attention, she’s now healthy and doing great.

The staff was incredibly patient with me, even when I had what felt like a million questions. They took the time to explain everything clearly, including what to expect after surgery and which signs to watch out for. Their hospitality and professionalism truly made a stressful situation so much easier.

I can’t thank them enough!

The veterinarian was in there all of one minute, didn’t answer many questions and left without providing clarification. This was the first time I’ve ever experienced that type of treatment at this location. Thank goodness, the young lady who was relaying information to and from her was Pleasant to work with. I truly hope I don’t ever have to meet with her again.
Owner-operated. Affordable. Been going here for decades. Save time and make an appointment. The staff are excellent.

Updated: No frills, low prices.  After many years I'm going to another practice. My family has been bringing our pets here for 20 years, but it has changed and not in a comforting way. It used to be clean but the last few years that I went it got dirtier and dirtier. The last visit there were blood drops on the exam room floor and hair all over the exam table. The experienced Dr. I used to see that it doesn't seem to be there any longer it's all young Doctors, good but   I miss the experience and trust of the older one. She knew what was going on and how to treat it quickly.  Then two Vet Techs came in and told us different after care, which happened a couple times in the last few years. We had to ask for clarity on the after care.The young Dr.s are brisk, overworked and have little time to discuss what's really happening with your pet, or listen to the pet owners. I really feel this place is good but the staff is overwhelmed and under supported. My lower rating is mostly for the confusion from the techs for after care.
Hello, I need to know if you can help me with my pet. I want to vaccinate him and take him abroad. Can you help me with the certificate and the microchip?
This place got recommended to me by a friend. So glad the staff is kind but most of all vets are awesome and very informative.

How this clinic is getting good reviews is beyond me, few years back my cat still dies after being seen, I was like okay she got bit, got an infection so they did their best, yest I took my other cat cuz he's been sick, spent close to $400 and today's he's worst. Worst vet place ever, don't know what they gave him but he's even more sick than when I took him. They pretty much killed this cat too .
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!

I took my dog in after being diagnosed with advanced Heartfailure due to heartworms. The veterinary doctor was very sweet and knowledgeable with my gentle giant Capone (100 lbs pitbull) her vet techs were also very sweet and caring. After being turned down by several facilities and prices ranging from $1000 to $3000. I was referred here and I can't thank them enough. He was given IV furosemide and medication to go home with. My bill was well under $1000 and everyone was really helpful and caring with my gentle giant. Definetly recommend.  If I could give more than 5 stars I would. I drove an hour to get to this facility and will do it again because they are caring and don't just want your money. I'm sorry I didnt cath the names of the doctor and vet techs. I will definitely be back.
The staff was amazing and the price for the services they are really good

I always make the time to come out despite the drive. I always receive top care for my pup, and it's obvious how much the entire staff cares about all of the animals. I've been here for a chronic UTI, soft tissue injury, and seasonal allergies. They've done well with everything. 100% recommend!

They have very competitive prices compared to the surrounding clinics. Is one of my go-to vets.
I have been using them for many years. The staff usually on point and my Dr made us feel welcomed.

When I first took my dog in November of 2024 for updated shots and an allergy shot, I was like ok this is a good replacement for my pet because the front desk was not too bad. When we went to the back, I was not too impressed by the vet tech and her non caring attitude. It kind of threw me off, because sometimes as a fur baby parent you have questions. She was not rough but not too gentle with my little guy either. So I waited for the veterinarian to come in, she was great to me and answered the questions I needed, without the hints of attitude.
With that experience I thought ok, not too bad. So I took him again in February for his allergy shots. Again front desk is great. Vet tech just came and grabbed him and took him to the back. I personally didn't like that and just informed her his site is bad to not startle him. The interaction was as if someone is hearing you but brushing you off. I was just thinking maybe it's me, maybe I am overthinking it.
However this last experience is it for me. My spouse took our baby and he had an accident on the floor. She had to clean it up herself and no assistance was given. No one came to help mop it up or anything. So how many other animals do that, without the staff ensuring the floor is cleaned frequently?  She also felt the same way about the vet tech when they came and grabbed him from her. The care and nurture was not seen by her and I never shared my prior experience with her about it.

I get it they are reasonable on price compared to other vet costs, but if you want your pet to be treated like you treat them I don't recommend them.
I personally will be taking my baby back to Long drive where the entire staff is kind and has no issues with any questions or hints of attitude vibing off of them.
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
My first time here, I came here for the more affordable price of putting down my dog. I couldn't have asked for a more friendly and understanding staff.

Dr. Palmer was extremely knowledgeable and data-driven when it came to diagnosing my cat’s infection. She performed the surgery the same day and we felt our cat was in good hands while in recovery 🩷 All the nurses were gentle and explained pre & post-op care in detail. They are transparent with the costs associated with everything. …
Very expensive, but they do a good job.
Great people. Decent place.

I like the vet that was talking to us she was sweet and honest about what was going on and she was not trying to run up the bill one of the nurses however to me was extremely rude for no reason other than that I did like this place everything seemed very affordable especially if you're more of a low income family

Quick, Affordable, and Caring

Not sure if this is standard, but I had a great experience. I showed up around 9 AM and was out by 10:14—even with needing X-rays! The staff was kind and efficient, and the price was very reasonable. I found them online and went because of a gift from a coworker, and I’m so glad I did.

If you can, try to get there early—it definitely helped speed things up. I’ll be coming back for sure.
Always a pleasant visit. The Vet here never tries to pull money outta ya if not deemed necessary. Super affordable and clean place.  I bring my dog and cats here.. def reccomend..
They’re so friendly and prices are very affordable

10 stars if that was a thing.  We were an 8am walk in with a semi emergency.  They got us to the back quickly, weren't afraid of my gentle giant.  The vet quickly felt around in her mouth to determine the problem.  On the second try she dislodged a small piece of bone from under the back of my dog's tongue.   Immediate relief from my dog and a few tears of relief from me.   A $39 exam fee later we were on our way.   Best experience I've had at a vet in a long time.  Glad that Long Drive (who no longer does walk ins and turned us away even though their parking lot and lobby were 100% empty) referred us to Gulf Gate.  We will be back.
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!

As many others have commented the employees up to including the doctor are just rude providing poor service. Saturdays can be crazy because only one doctor working and don’t be one minute late because they will not see you.
Thank you for the paw-sitive review!
Horrible... been going here for 10 plus years... new vetinary doctor and all she is concerned about is brining in money. Not concerned about your pet.  Changing vet due to this.

My miniature schnauzer Barney was served here is entire 13 years of life and was put to rest here with us. Although there are very few more sad things than having to say goodbye to a beloved dog with the vet, everyone was so caring and gave us plenty of time together. I was not made to feel like it was just a routine procedure for them.

I still travel across town to have my two current dogs cared for and have always been given great and gentle care. I feel like it's worth the drive.  Prices are very fair and wait times are not unreasonable.

Used to be a nice and friendly place.

I encountered a frustrating experience when I was trying to resolve an issue. The representative initially looked up the wrong account, then asked me for my phone number, claiming that was how they pull up accounts. Unfortunately, he ended up pulling up the wrong account again and repeatedly questioned the information I provided. At that point, I pointed out my phone number on the sign-in form, but he proceeded to reference a completely different number and name while continuing to question me.

Instead of acknowledging his mistake or the rude behavior, he quietly apologized as if nothing was wrong. The level of rudeness I experienced is hard to put into words, so I'll leave it at that.

Additionally, it seems like they expect customers to cover for them rather than speak the truth. It's a shame.

The front desk employee, Alex, seems to think it's acceptable to be rude to customers as long as he apologizes afterward, even though he was the one who made the mistake. Fabulous employee

Per the manager, "You didn't give us a chance to explain." Explain being rude?? I'm not sure how that justifies poor customer service.
